question: Who among the following won the ‘3rd Rabindranath Tagore Literary Prize’ for his novel ‘The City and The Sea’ in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raj Kamal Jha.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• **Raj Kamal Jha** is a newspaper editor and novelist in India.
 
• He is currently the Editor-in-Chief of The Indian Express.
 
• He was honoured with the **3rd Rabindranath Tagore Literary Prize**’ for his novel** ‘The City and The Sea’ **in December 2020.
 
• In September 2021, he was honoured with the **Editor of The Year award** by the India Chapter of the International Advertising Association.
 
• He was honoured with the **Commonwealth Writers Prize** for Best First Book for his work 'The Blue Bedspread' in 2000.
 
• He was awarded** JCB Prize for Literature **for his novel The City and The Sea in 2019.
 
• Notable works of Raj Kamal Jha are:
 
 
• The City And The Sea.
 
• She Will Build Him A City.
 
• Fireproof.
 
• Zwischen den Welten.
 
• If You Are Afraid of Heights.
 
• The Blue Bedspread.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Siddhartha Sarma** is an Indian English novelist from Assam best known for his novel **"The Grasshopper's Run".**
 
• **Shekhar Gupta **is an Indian journalist and the founder of the online newspaper **'ThePrint'.**
 
• **Rajdeep Sardesai **is an Indian journalist and author who was honoured with the Padma Shri award in 2008.
